description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' used for serializing and deserializing reference types with surrogate support in Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing values, converting between surrogate and actual types, and references external serializers and codecs.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing serialization logic for reference types with surrogate support, including methods for reading, writing, and converting surrogate types.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the input, handling references and surrogate conversion.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField, converting it to a surrogate if necessary, and handling reference serialization.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a surrogate value to the actual field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a field value to its surrogate representation.
